card.name: Digits inside dates and numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token that starts or sits inside a date, day range, year, or other number, such as the day in a date or the last two digits of a year. It is common in web dates like 02/24/05 or 6–12 May.

modes.label: Year digits in slash dates
modes.description: The digit after a slash and a leading zero in a numeric date, completing a two-digit year.

modes.label: Day or other number digit
modes.description: The first digit of a day, count or code number in text, such as a day range or a citation.

card.plain: It fires on a single digit that is part of a date or number, such as a day or year.
